# Bob Vila

> > Trusted home improvement resource featuring DIY tutorials, renovation guides, and expert advice from America's original home improvement expert.

Bob Vila is a comprehensive home improvement and lifestyle website offering practical how-to guides, design inspiration, and product recommendations for homeowners, DIYers, and renters. The site covers everything from major renovations and outdoor projects to cleaning tips, upcycling crafts, and seasonal decor.

## Key Topics

- DIY projects and tutorials
- Home improvement and renovation
- Interior design and home decor
- Upcycling and repurposing
- Cleaning and maintenance tips
- Crawl space solutions and moisture control
- Composting and sustainable living
- Storage and organization
- Outdoor living and landscaping
- Renter-friendly modifications
- Bathroom and kitchen updates
- Seasonal home projects
- Budget-friendly home fixes
- Space-saving solutions

## Home Improvement & Renovation Guides

- [How to Resurface Laminate Countertops](https://www.bobvila.com/articles/refinishing-laminate-countertops): DIY tutorial for refinishing laminate countertops with acrylic coating
- [Converting Your Crawl Space into a Storage Area (Quick Guide)](https://www.bobvila.com/articles/crawl-space-solutions): Guide to converting crawl space into storage with moisture control tips
- [11 Renter-Friendly Ideas for a Reversible Remodel](https://www.bobvila.com/slideshow/11-renter-friendly-ideas-for-a-reversible-remodel-50799): 11 temporary decor solutions for renters using peel-and-stick materials
- [10 Quick Fixes for a More Refreshing Shower](https://www.bobvila.com/slideshow/10-quick-fixes-for-a-more-refreshing-shower-48186): 10 bathroom maintenance tips for improving shower experience and comfort

## Cleaning & Maintenance

- [How to Clean Chrome](https://www.bobvila.com/articles/how-to-clean-chrome): How-to guide for cleaning chrome fixtures and keeping them gleaming
- [15 Cleaning Mistakes Everyone Makes](https://www.bobvila.com/slideshow/15-cleaning-mistakes-everyone-makes-48635): Common household cleaning mistakes and how to correct them
- [How to Get Rid of Musty Smell - Old Books](https://www.bobvila.com/articles/how-to-get-rid-of-musty-smell): How to remove musty odors from old books using cornstarch

- [10 Things to Do with Cross-Cut Trees](https://www.bobvila.com/slideshow/10-things-to-do-with-cross-cut-trees-24264): 10 rustic DIY projects using tree slices for home decor crafts

## Storage & Organization

- [14 New Things You Can Do with an Old Sweater](https://www.bobvila.com/slideshow/14-new-things-you-can-do-with-an-old-sweater-50561): 14 creative ways to upcycle old sweaters into crafts and home decor
